import re
def parse(p):
    t=open(p,encoding='utf-8').read()
    t=re.sub(r'/\*.*?\*/','',t,flags=re.DOTALL)
    pat=re.compile(r'\"((?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\.)*)\"\s*=\s*\"((?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\.)*)\"\s*;',re.DOTALL)
    return {m.group(1):m.group(2) for m in pat.finditer(t)}
en=parse('Hanahuac/en.lproj/Localizable.strings')
pl=parse('Hanahuac/pl.lproj/Localizable.strings')
def specs(s): return sorted(re.findall(r'%(?:\d+\$)?[@dfsu]', s))
mism=[]
for k in en:
    if k in pl and specs(en[k])!=specs(pl[k]):
        mism.append((k,specs(en[k]),specs(pl[k])))
print('keys en=%d pl=%d'%(len(en),len(pl)))
print('missing in pl:', sorted(set(en)-set(pl)))
print('extra in pl:', sorted(set(pl)-set(en)))
print('format-spec mismatches:', mism if mism else 'NONE')
"
